method: Lexical/source candidates plus manual objective comparisons. Four repeated draft concepts were replaced, including a legacy overlap; heuristic flags are not proof of semantic uniqueness.

records.reason: FETCH_LAZY tests reuse of one row-view object; fetchColumn tests advancing rows while choosing a column. One preserves a scalar snapshot and compares object identity, the other makes three fetch calls.
Composite continuation predicates are unrelated to using SELECT rowCount as an emptiness check; shared SQLite setup creates source overlap.
Prequoting a bound data value corrupts apostrophes; identifier allowlisting controls SQL syntax. Both use PDO but require different boundaries and repairs.
Pagination compares ordering tuples; grouped fetches preserve repeated grouping keys. Neither operation supplies the other's answer.
rowCount is a wrong cleanup operation here, not an emptiness predicate. The tested guarantee is release of an active SQLite schema lock.
Parameter preprocessing changes stored data; fetchColumn advances an existing result cursor. Common query calls do not share the tested mechanism.
Closing a cursor releases read resources; selecting a column advances a row. The DROP failure is not derivable from row-position output alone.
A complete ordering tuple determines pagination; bindParam's retained reference determines later input values. SQL setup is incidental overlap.
Row-cursor advancement does not concern safe SQL identifier selection. The former uses fixed selected column positions and no dynamic SQL identifier.
Active-cursor resource lifetime controls DROP; a live PDORow view controls retained row data. Object aliasing is not the lock-release operation.
The lazy row is output-side shared state; bindParam is input-side deferred reference state. The object identity and scalar snapshot trace is a separate mechanism.
FETCH_LAZY aliasing is unrelated to SELECT rowCount portability; no row count is used in the new question.
Reset format position controls unspecified fields; ISO week-year formatting labels a fully specified date. Different DateTime contracts.
Composite SQL filtering is independent of FETCH_LAZY object reuse; the pagination result uses ordinary column values.
A fetched lazy row view is not an SQL identifier placeholder or allowlist problem.
Repeated fetchColumn calls move the result cursor; repeated executions with bindParam observe a retained input reference. Read versus input binding state differs.
The new trace observes rows consumed by fetchColumn, not a SELECT rowCount estimate.
The pagination query selects rows using a compound ordering predicate; fetchColumn's row consumption is not used to derive the continuation rule.
No Fiber or transaction sharing occurs in the row-advancement trace. The earlier question is connection ownership across interleaving tasks.
Column selection across successive fetches differs from grouping all rows under nonunique keys.
The four queries are fixed trusted alternatives; the question tests cursor ordering, not parameterizing SQL identifiers.
Delegated final return is explicitly yielded in the new trace; the earlier limiter must avoid advancing a source one item too far.
One reused PDORow view differs from grouped arrays preserving repeated keys; the former demonstrates identity aliasing, not grouping policy.
Explicit nullable parameter syntax removes a deprecation; integer overflow violates a return contract. Shared typed-function code is incidental.
bindValue data must not be quoted, whereas bindParam retains a variable reference. Apostrophe corruption is independent of deferred reference timing.
Stored data corruption from prequoting is independent of output row-view aliasing.
A parsing reset establishes missing fields; immutable timezone conversion preserves an existing instant. The input and operation contracts differ.
Reset-before-parse supplies an epoch baseline; @timestamp construction followed by timezone conversion changes display zone. No timestamp-zone override is tested here.
The memory query has no shared transaction or Fiber. Similar PDO boilerplate does not duplicate transaction ownership reasoning.
Readonly's default protected setter scope allows one child initialization; asymmetric private(set) rejection concerns an ordinary property's restricted setter and partial writes.
The delegated return becomes an explicit outer yield; the earlier generator question concerns send implicitly starting an unstarted generator and its next suspension.
__call receives unknown named arguments as an ordered string-key map; func_get_args reports bound declared parameters in declaration order.
Self-access inside a backed hook avoids recursive dispatch; raw Reflection writes deliberately bypass hooks from outside. Distinct dispatch paths.
Constant name identity is case-sensitive; str_contains tests string needle matching including an empty needle. Similar wording is not the same API or rule.
Pure enum JSON has no default scalar representation; backed enum name versus value is a separate property distinction.
Associative decoding must satisfy an array return type; numeric-key object/list round trips lose JSON shape. The new fixture has ordinary named members and no reindexing.
BCMath decimal comparison scale differs from prefix byte comparison length. Each requires a different distinguishing fixture and numeric/string contract.
Implicit nullable defaults are deprecated in PHP 8.4; required-after-optional ordering changes call requirements. The new declaration has only one optional parameter.
The new parser must distinguish a quoted comma within one record; the earlier reader must span a physical newline to assemble a logical record before parsing.
__get without __isset controls magic reads and presence checks; an exported reference bypasses asymmetric setter visibility. No reference or restricted setter appears in 0513.
never is a covariant bottom return type that cannot return normally; nullable fallthrough is a missing explicit return. Different type and control-flow obligations.
Known source encoding must be transcoded before JSON encoding; associative JSON decoding chooses an array representation. Opposite serialization stages and different guarantees.
The new include distinguishes global named function declaration from inherited local variable scope; the earlier example only follows a configuration variable assignment.
Named function declaration scope after include is unrelated to inherited method static-local storage sharing.
A PDO lazy view is reused by fetch; a clone hook constructs a different object and does not rerun a constructor. Shared words about object state do not share the mechanism.
A global uncaught handler terminates the script afterward; an exception thrown inside catch skips sibling catches and reaches an outer boundary.
An explicit set-hook input union and typed getter differ from magic getter/isset dispatch. The former normalizes assigned input; the latter performs reads without a setter.
never governs whether a method returns normally; postfix increment governs the value of a normal return expression.
Spaceship produces normalized ordering signs; numeric-string comparison selects numeric versus lexical semantics. The new operands are integers and do not test string coercion.
Final class inheritance restrictions are unrelated to upload provenance in a CLI fixture; low lexical overlap is incidental review phrasing.

The earlier append-only descending unique-ID cursor needs one monotonic key. The new mutable insertion position and timestamp ties require the complete (created,id) tuple; ID-only continuation demonstrably fails.
Postfix return expression values are independent of empty() on Countable objects.
Character transcoding maps known source characters into UTF-8; base64 of a raw HMAC concerns binary versus hexadecimal digest representation.
An array return contract controls JSON object decoding; top-level-only object encoding preserves nested lists. The direction and target representation differ.
405 requires Allow for resource method availability; 204 prohibits response content. Separate HTTP status obligations, not a changed status number on the same task.
Negative rounding directions concern numeric values; numeric-string array keys concern key canonicalization and collisions.
PDORow live-view reuse occurs inside the PDO fetch API; copied arrays sharing an explicitly referenced element use PHP reference containers.
Magic getter presence behavior does not concern interface membership versus concrete class identity. The actual duplicate draft at 0549 was replaced separately.
never covariance and void incompatibility do not concern function-name versus variable-name case sensitivity.
Underscores separate digits in a source literal; octal leading-zero literals differ from decimal numeric strings. Different syntax and runtime comparison inputs.
Final class restrictions differ from array_walk changing a local key without renaming the source key. The word-level flag is generic review phrasing, with no source similarity.
Canonical Base64 pad bits are distinct from canonical filesystem directory-prefix boundaries; both use canonicalization terminology but protect different representations.
Delegated generator return propagation differs from nested positional array destructuring and skipped positions.
Yield-from return values differ from array chunk grouping and preserved inner keys.
Included named function scope is unrelated to ordinary object assignment aliasing.
An unsupported pure enum JSON representation is not an object assignment-versus-clone question.
Lazy row identity reuse differs from ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH callback argument order and retained array keys.
Postfix versus prefix affects expression values; null coalescing versus truthy default affects fallback admission. Distinct operator contracts.
A leap-century regression fixture differs from filtered-list JSON shape; common test-selection wording is incidental.
Final does not freeze object state; nullsafe chains must protect each nullable hop. The tested modifiers and failure conditions differ.
never return covariance is unrelated to define's Boolean success result versus its constant value.
Unicode case-fold expansion and array label frequency counts share no implementation rule despite common words about values.

file flags strip LF while preserving a meaningful empty physical record; the earlier CSV policy skips physical blanks but retains quoted-empty and zero fields. Different parsers, representations and retention contracts.
Constant-name case sensitivity differs from a constant's global availability versus a local variable's scope.
__call receives named arguments for an undefined method; a declared variadic parameter collects unmatched names after ordinary binding. The dispatch boundary and argument order premise differ.

The new package must allow class discovery without starting network integrations; the earlier domain service must receive parsed deployment configuration. Discovery side effects versus input composition boundaries.
Final class semantics do not concern a redirect helper returning to a caller; incidental review-language similarity.
Final inheritance restrictions are unrelated to ASCII-only strtolower; neither code nor required rule overlaps.
Final class mutation is distinct from integer overflow to float violating a return declaration.
never return substitution concerns normal termination; by-reference generator declarations expose mutable yielded storage. Both declarations use function syntax for different guarantees.
Adding a string union member changes weak coercion; exporting a first-class private callable preserves visibility authority. No callable scope is involved in the new refactor.
Nowdoc preserves variable-looking text and excludes its delimiter boundary newline; the earlier implementation chooses an LF escape literal. Different literal syntax and required byte sequences.
Constant-name case sensitivity differs from when a default-argument constant is evaluated at call time.
The include case juxtaposes declaration scope with local execution scope; the earlier question compares a preexisting global constant to a local variable.
Set-hook input widening does not concern assignment grouping with and versus &&.
A foreach value copy needs keyed writeback; case sensitivity of function and variable names does not establish array aliasing.
Final class semantics and name-case lookup are independent language rules.
Final inheritance restrictions do not sanitize state or traces; SensitiveParameter redaction has an entirely separate exception-trace boundary.
min rejects an empty array; array_walk_recursive skips containers. A nullable return guard and a traversal strategy are different repairs.
Century exceptions distinguish calendar rules; thousands separators distinguish numeric wire formatting. Common test phrasing does not duplicate a concept.
Decimal scale precision tests do not involve Fiber interleaving or a single-use claim race.
A reused PDO row view changes observed data; readonly child initialization controls one assignment to inherited storage.
Generator return propagation is unrelated to fresh new-expression defaults per omitted argument.
PDO row advancement and closure value-capture local reset concern unrelated state lifetimes.
The return expression's old numeric value differs from a redirect helper's inability to terminate its caller.
Postfix result semantics differ from direct Boolean output failing a JSON Boolean contract.
The replaced draft was too close to abstract-class instantiation. The final question now tests final versus immutability, including valid mutation and cloning, without an abstract class.
POSIX unlink retains open-handle access; final classes permit object mutation and cloning. Both discuss lifetime restrictions but use independent mechanisms.
A process-shared error-handler stack across Fibers differs from class finality; lexical review wording is incidental.
A durable per-key nonce allocator prevents reuse across crashes; an authorization cache key identifies decision inputs. Different state invariants and failure schedules.
String-versus-integer exit controls stdout and process status; the earlier subprocess test observes skipped finally cleanup. Separate exit contracts and assertions.
Pure enum JSON failure differs from empty-needle substring semantics; no shared executable rule.
Weak ETag comparison and decimal comparison scale each need a distinguishing test, but operate under unrelated protocol and arithmetic equivalence rules.
Manual extra: full Unicode case folding expands sharp s even when Unicode lowercasing is available; the earlier defect is ASCII-only strtolower on accented uppercase text.

Manual extra: short reads may occur before EOF and must accumulate a fixed-width frame; the earlier fgets limit truncates a newline-delimited record. Stream delivery versus physical line-boundary policy differs.
Manual extra: reading a fixed frame must distinguish short delivery from EOF; writing all bytes must advance by accepted-byte counts. The callbacks, termination conditions and error cases differ.
Manual extra: the rejected draft repeated CSV blank-record handling. The final question has no CSV and tests partial frame reads under an explicit callback contract.
Manual extra: the rejected strict-float draft duplicated this legacy item. The final nowdoc question has no numeric parameter or coercion and tests literal source text.
Manual extra: the rejected interface-membership draft duplicated 0208. The final empty-minimum question has no interface or class-identity comparison.
Manual extra: both include a mutator-return trap, but flat multi-element append versus nested insertion is the new primary contract; sorting order and usort's Boolean result are not used.

Manual extra: reversing all entries changes order while preserving numeric identities; selecting a tail slice preserves order within a subset. Distinct operations, though both teach integer-key policy.
Manual extra: descriptor survival after unlink is a direct lifecycle trace; consistent file response metadata requires fstat on the same opened immutable version during rename publication.
Manual extra: normalized username identity plus concurrent uniqueness differs from an idempotency claim controlling whether an effect is applied inside a transaction.

Manual extra: durable handoff must precede acknowledgement because FPM is not detached; the earlier outbox question requires atomicity between a database change and publication intent, explicitly absent here.

Manual extra: an interface constructor restores a signature obligation even though ordinary parent constructors can vary. The earlier late-static factory fails because it assumes that parent signature is inherited as a contract.
